revision_note: v1.1 corrects the half-point rounding specification to floor(x)+0.5 so every research line ends in .5. This is a disclosed specification correction before publication, not outcome-based tuning; eligibility remains fail-closed.
status: Exploratory retrospective protocol. Historical outcomes were already visible when this protocol was written; this is NOT prospective preregistration.

team_model.notes: No fitted coefficients. Current weight = current GP/(current GP+prior_strength). Opponent points derived as official PTS minus official PLUS/MINUS; both inputs are rounded. Win probability is an uncalibrated logistic heuristic, not a validated betting probability.

player_model.binary_candidate: Normal CDF using trailing mean and sample SD (ddof=1) of up to 10 prior games; threshold is a half-point research threshold.
player_model.binary_baseline: Expanding empirical hit rate with Beta(1,1) smoothing: (hits+1)/(n+2).
player_model.notes: Thresholds are analyst-chosen constants, not observed sportsbook lines. No threshold tuning after evaluation. All forecasts use strictly earlier games.

inference.multiplicity: Holm step-down within each declared family; no cross-family claim of overall error control.
inference.binary_skill_test: Paired date-cluster bootstrap of candidate-minus-baseline Brier loss; two-sided bootstrap-null p; 95% percentile CI. Negative difference favors candidate.
inference.same_game_correlation_test: Within-player permutation of one stat vector; two-sided absolute Pearson r null.
inference.lag1_test: Within-player permutation of the next-game vector; two-sided absolute Pearson r null. Failure to reject is NOT proof of independence.
inference.joint_hit_test: Two-sided Fisher exact test on the 2x2 hit table for two-prop combos. Three-prop combos are descriptive only.
inference.notes: Date clusters preserve same-date cross-player dependence in binary skill resampling. Within-player game resampling/permutation assumes exchangeable games and is exploratory. No luck-removal claim.

power_planning.notes: Normal-approximation planning only; exact binomial power is also reported at the approximate n. Example odds are arithmetic, not an observed market quote.

validation_gates.required: Every gate must PASS or be explicitly N/A. UNKNOWN/FAIL blocks eligibility. No synthetic ledger can satisfy a gate.
validation_gates.reward: Badges only; funded monetary pool is blank/unverified. Rank eligible strategies by lower 95% date-cluster bootstrap bound of mean net profit per unit stake; ties by more graded bets, then lower max drawdown.

prohibited: Do not invent sportsbook prices, availability, payouts, or graded bets.
Do not call contextual citations proof of an edge.
Do not rank or reward an ineligible strategy.
Do not edit other sessions' files; publish corrections additively.
Do not merge before build, tests, and site checks pass.
